svg.aria-label: Bundle engine and storage seam. How core-owned OKF semantics remain consistent across filesystem, memory, and remote storage adapters.
svg.title: Superbee bundle engine and storage seam
svg.desc: Human, CLI, UI, MCP, publication, and server callers enter one core bundle engine. Core owns identity safety, OKF validation, query predicates, graph derivation, and mutation policy. The StorageBackend contract carries versioned documents, reserved files, blobs, history, and an optional head projection to filesystem, memory, or remote HTTP adapters. Backend optimization cannot redefine core semantics.
